disposition_reason: Laboratory monitoring of lead, cadmium and arsenic in seven food groups, including bakery and confectionery, is shown only as bar charts of the share of results per concentration interval; no concentrations per food are printed.

study.design: Summary of testing-laboratory monitoring results by food group
study.method: not stated (standards and equipment manuals cited generically)

unresolved: Only interval statements are printed (e.g. most bakery and confectionery results for Pb in the '< 0.01 mg/kg' interval, Cd '< 0.001 mg/kg', As '< 0.02 mg/kg'); these are shares of results, not concentrations, and are not findings.
Number of samples per food group, analytical method and LOD are not reported.
